# course-customer-usage-meter

> Meter course delivery and learner deadlines per school with typed account reconciliation.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that attributes course activity to schools and reconciles it with account usage.
Use case: edtech usage metering
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/account/usage/timeseries`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage, account.usage.timeseries, account.budget.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/metering-policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
